candidate.definition_en: To express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تعرف تعبر عن أفكارك وتتكلم بوضوح وطلاقة.

senses.definition_en: To express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently.
senses.explanation_ar: أن تعبر عن أفكارك أو مشاعرك بوضوح وطلاقة.

examples: She struggled to articulate her feelings.
The teacher helped him articulate his thoughts.
He was able to articulate the complex theory simply.
